name: reachinbox-email-scheduler
description: ReachInbox-style production email scheduler: BullMQ + Redis + Postgres + Ethereal + Elasticsearch + React dashboard

scripts.setup: docker compose up -d && npm --prefix server run migrate && npm --prefix server run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
